description: Hey, I'm Wout. I'm a software engineer who loves building robust backend systems, tinkering with servers at home, and playing badminton at a competitive level.
extendedBio: By day I work as a software engineer, mostly on the backend side of things. I like systems that are well-structured and make sense, whether that's a service I'm designing at work or a homelab project I'm setting up at 11pm for no good reason.

I currently work on supply chain software at Volvo Cars with the DEVEX team, and I got my start partly through a love of problem-solving, which once took me to the finals of the CyberSecurity Challenge Belgium during my studies.

Outside of work, badminton takes up a good chunk of my time. I play at a national competitive level (top 60 in Belgium, top 16 at this year's Belgian Championships), coach a handful of top players individually, and help run sessions at De Pluimplukkers, the biggest badminton club in Belgium. I also run, swim, and do calisthenics when I can, with the occasional half marathon thrown in.

When things slow down, you'll find me with a fantasy novel, a good series, or a cup of coffee somewhere nice. I like travelling, I'm endlessly curious about new tools and technologies, and I have a slight obsession with making my dev environment just a little bit cleaner.

education.degree: Master of Science in Industrial Engineering
